pages.text:
For a scald Head.

Take pison & Eanse seeth them together, make a plaister herof shaut of the haire and apply it somewhat hott.

To make Breath sweet

Take the powder of Sage, of winter Savoric, of Cloves & mace nutmegg all powders a litle musk steeped in juice of Lemons & white wine, drink of this compound a spoonfull or two morning & night.

A water to cleare hands & face

Take a quart of fair water, a pint of white wine, the juice of 4. Lemons, put therin Beanblossems, white lilly Blossoms, Elder blossomes, of each one handfull, put to it 4 whole Daizy roots 4 marsh mallow roots, 2. or 3. Branches of wild tansy as much flumitorie, the weight of 2d in camphire, put all these in an earthen pott, sett it in warm Ashes all night, in the morning strain it through a peice of white cotton, put it in a narrow mouthed glasse, sett it in the heat of the sun 3 or 4 dayes, if there bee any pimples or freckles in the face take a quantitie of water in the glasse & steep the white dung of an hen in it one night, then strane it through a cloth, wash your face w th this morning & night, if your hands, adde three or 4 bruised Almonds this is a most excellint water, prob.

A powder for teeth

Take the powder of Sage, the shavings of Ivory put y m among the juice of Lemons, night & morn, rubb your teeth herwith, it will make them both white & sweet.

To kill Quicksilver

Putt it into a glass viol, put fasting spittle to it, stopp the viol with wax then shake it till it look like Ashes.

For a sore throat

Take 3 d of quicksilver, put it in a wooden dish & kill it with w th fasting spitle then take 4 th of oyle of Bayes, put to it the juice of Sage leaves, so grind all well together & putt it in a gally pott to keep it all the yeare, annoint y crown of the head & y nape of the neck, lay a very little at once, so do it when you goe to bed, keep you warm, thrice dressing with care, prob.

Another

Quicker pills & Iron cares 1 d Boyle them in a quart of posset ale till y 3 d part bee consumed, let em remain in y drink, take 8 spoonfulls night & morning.

Another

Mr Briscoe Take a great Onion, cutt of y topp, fill it with Luce honey, roast it w th y topp on, when rosted, take & bind it to the nape of y neck this will cure.

For a Quinsy

Take Alburgracu, beat it to powder, put to it a pint of strong Ale & honey to sweeten it, then strain it, put Nutmeg to give it a taste if it

'shaut of the haire' is probably a transcription of 'shaved off the hair', so the step wording is a guess.
